visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a store display at Haneda Airport featuring 'Butter no Itoko' souvenirs with warm indoor lighting and colorful signage. (2) Hands hold a black and gold N.Y.C. SAND cylindrical package in a retail setting with background shoppers visible as blurred figures. (3) A bright yellow box of 'Tokyo LEMONCHE' is shown on a shelf, then a hand opens the box and breaks a round, yellow-filled macaron-style cookie to show the creamy texture. (4) Transitioning to a white and red package with a rabbit illustration for Kamakura Goro; hands unwrap the individual cookie and split a round, cream-filled sandwich cookie apart. (5) A stack of yellow boxes with a black cow logo for 'Butter Cookie Salt Cream Sand' is displayed, followed by a hand breaking a rectangular sandwich cookie to reveal a thick white cream center. (6) A soft dorayaki pancake is shown in a blue and white wrapper, then broken open to show red bean and salt butter filling. (7) Final scenes show airport international signage, additional retail storefronts like 'Audrey', and a graphic outro with social media icons and text overlays.
